278444369.description:
Natural Amethyst Crystal Cluster
Deep Purple Geode Fragment
Natural Mineral Specimen, 3.47 Pounds
This substantial amethyst crystal cluster features a dense concentration of terminated quartz points in varying shades of deep purple. A classic geological specimen, amethyst is prized by collectors for its vibrant coloration and unique crystalline formations, often used as a centerpiece for home decor or within mineral collections for its aesthetic and geological interest.
Numerous natural crystal terminations with characteristic hexagonal faceting
Deep purple saturation with translucent to semi-opaque clarity across the points
Natural rocky matrix base providing a stable foundation for upright display
Substantial size with a verified weight of 3.47 pounds
Condition:
Natural specimen with primary crystalline structures intact. No large-scale shearing or significant damage to the main cluster terminations. The underside displays the raw, unpolished host rock matrix typical of geode extractions. Natural mineral inclusions and slight surface dust consistent with storage are present.
